Fixtures whose golden .bench is the corrected output of yosysJsonToBench.js, NOT the Python original's.
The Python converter (1) did not recognise many Yosys storage cells (it emitted e.g. "q = BUFF(clk)") and
(2) could not express constants: a constant reaching a $_MUX_/$_ANDNOT_/$_ORNOT_ became BUFF(first input).
On Yosys 0.9 a synchronous reset IS such a mux. Each golden here was checked for functional equivalence with
the Yosys netlist (test/helpers/benchEval.js). The live Python cross-check test skips the names listed here.
abc033_d133
abc033_d92
edge_const_inputs
y09_d37
y09_d45
